partnership_angle: Referral partner (with sandbox-tester entry). DDS is the archetypal high-volume boutique: ~200 SOC 2 exams a year, heavily startup-weighted, and already monetizing the GRC-automation ecosystem (Drata Registered Alliance Member, Vanta discounts, Secureframe, Hyperproof). They have proven they will recommend third-party readiness tooling to pre-audit clients, so LoxeAI slots into an existing referral motion rather than requiring a new behavior. Caveats: at ~40 staff they are the largest firm in the target band, founded 2003 (not a young firm), and their multi-tool GRC commitments mean LoxeAI must position as a complement (pre-engagement AWS readiness scan) rather than a Vanta/Drata competitor. Not a white-label fit — they have their own brand and volume.
pitch_note: Dan, you built DDS's SOC 2 practice around automation-first audits — 200 exams a year, mostly cloud-native SaaS startups on AWS. LoxeAI is an AWS-native SOC 2 readiness scanner built for exactly those pre-audit clients; before we pitch a single startup, we want an auditor of your caliber to pressure-test it. Run the scan on a sandbox AWS account on a 30-minute call — if it holds up, your pre-engagement clients get told 'run this first, it gets you ~80% ready,' and DDS gets cleaner evidence and faster Type IIs without adding headcount.
